arms_blocked.mouse_gene_attribution: No real, honestly-licensed linked mouse transcriptome was obtained: NeMO dat-m2kd56v (transcriptome) now shows 'No license listed' on re-check (2026-11-23), and no confirmed cell-linked accession was found for this cohort during prior project scoping. Gene expression input is therefore absent and build_attribution_table()/stability selection/attribution models were never invoked on real data.

note: This summary describes a REAL-DATA run: mouse ephys+metadata from the Allen Institute Cell Types Database REST API (Gouwens 2020 Cre-line overlapping cohort), human ephys from a real downloaded subset of DANDI:000636 (CC-BY-4.0), features extracted with ipfx. No synthetic or substituted data is included. This is an ephys-ONLY phenotypic comparison across species; it makes no causal or gene-attribution claims, and the mouse gene-attribution arm was not run (see arms_blocked above) due to lack of accessible, properly licensed linked transcriptome data.
